capabilities.transcription: Turn audio and video into text
capabilities.speechSynthesis: Speech synthesis, voice cloning and design
capabilities.speechAlignment: Align transcript text precisely to audio

modelDescriptions.whisperTiny: Fast and lightweight; lower accuracy on difficult recordings.
modelDescriptions.whisperLargeV3: More accurate transcription with longer processing times.
modelDescriptions.mossNano: Lightweight Chinese and English speech with preset voices and voice cloning.
modelDescriptions.voxCpm2: Full model for voice cloning and design.
modelDescriptions.voxCpm2Q8: Voice cloning and design with a smaller model.
modelDescriptions.qwen3Aligner: Full transcript alignment model; up to five minutes at a time.
modelDescriptions.qwen3AlignerQ8: Lightweight transcript alignment model; up to five minutes at a time.
modelDescriptions.sherpaDiarization: Lightweight speaker identification with automatic or specified speaker count.
modelDescriptions.spleeter2Stems: Lightweight vocal and accompaniment separation; audio up to ten minutes.
modelDescriptions.u2netp: Lightweight background removal with faster processing.
modelDescriptions.u2net: Full background removal model with longer processing times.
modelDescriptions.sherpaDiarizationFull: Full-precision speaker identification with automatic or specified speaker count.
modelDescriptions.spleeter2StemsFull: Full-precision vocal and accompaniment separation; audio up to ten minutes.
modelDescriptions.realEsrganGeneralX4v3: Compact general image upscaling. Native ×4 inference; output can be sized to 2K, 4K or 8K.
modelDescriptions.realEsrganX4plus: Full general image upscaling model; longer CPU processing times.
modelDescriptions.migan: Brush or smart-selection repair. Unselected pixels are preserved; no text-guided object search.
modelDescriptions.efficientSamTi: Compact point and box selection with exclusion points. Produces a binary mask, not hair-level matting.
modelDescriptions.efficientSamS: Larger point and box selection model with the same editing controls.
modelDescriptions.depthAnythingV2Small: Full-precision relative inverse depth. Near objects appear brighter; this is not a distance measurement.
modelDescriptions.depthAnythingV2SmallUint8: Smaller quantized relative inverse-depth model. Near objects appear brighter; this is not a distance measurement.

localModels.selectedVoiceModel: For new reference voices; saved voices are unaffected.
